content: Vercel/Geist: near-white body + near-black ink + 200-step gray scale; borders implemented as box-shadow (0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.08)) rather than literal CSS borders to avoid doubled edges; Geist Mono for code/technical labels; dense tables require tabular numerals, right-aligned numbers, frozen headers, zebra striping as baseline. Raycast uses rgba(255,255,255,.06) near-invisible borders and GeistMono for shortcut/metadata labels.
